Priya Rao: quick sync — finalizing the postmortem action matrix from inc-834. I sketched owners/dates in the doc but need confirmation before I lock the closure checklist.
Kevin Li: saw the doc, will take the IR reproducibility item (data sampling script). target EOD Wed for a PR.
Samir Patel: I can pick up the rollout rollback runbook updates. pushing a draft by tomorrow morning. @Kevin Li can you add the sampling command example?
Kevin Li: yep — will add `python infra/scripts/sample_kv_trace.py --start 2026-03-10 --limit 50` and a short note on env vars.
Maria Gomez: I'm the primary for telemetry gaps + dashboard alerts. ETA Friday COB. will add alert thresholds and a short remediation playbook.
Priya Rao: thanks. two cross-team asks: (1) integration test for prefix cache invalidate — who owns? (2) confirm who will run the canary cutover smoke on staging.
Samir Patel: I'll own the integration test, but need a pairing window with infra. propose Thu 10–11am PST for a quick run.
Kevin Li: I'll run the staging smoke for the canary cutover Thu 12:30pm PST. keeping it in my calendar.
Maria Gomez: +1 on Thu pairing. I'll do alert validation right after the smoke (target 1pm PST).
Oncall Bot: reminder set: inc-834 postmortem action owners confirmation meeting in 24 hours. Link: https://meet.redwood/s/pm-834
Priya Rao: tagging action items to the doc now. Let's try to keep owner -> PR link -> ETA pattern. If anyone needs to shift, reply here with new ETA. :thumbsup:
Kevin Li: PR link for sampling script will be posted in this thread when created: https://git.redwood/p/sample-kv-trace/pull/145
Samir Patel: draft runbook PR: https://git.redwood/p/rollout-runbooks/pull/62 — still needs a few commands filled in.
Maria Gomez: dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/p/telemetry/pull/281 — adding alert test plan.
Priya Rao: great. current matrix snapshot: reproducibility — Kevin (EOD Wed), runbook — Samir (Thu AM), integration test — Samir + infra (Thu 10–11am), staging smoke — Kevin (Thu 12:30pm), telemetry — Maria (Fri COB). I'll freeze the matrix at 5pm PT today unless changes posted here.
Kevin Li: noted. if infra blocks the test, I'll switch to running a limited unit regression and update ETA.
Samir Patel: will ping infra now. thanks.
Priya Rao: closing note — add any risks under the doc 'open risks' section, and paste short test commands here so SRE can replicate. I'll follow up after freeze.
